mechanism: Cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially reducing adalimumab exposure; additionally, TNF-alpha inhibitors may increase seizure risk in some patients, conflicting with cenobamate's anticonvulsant mechanism.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of adalimumab and consider therapeutic drug monitoring; ensure seizure control is maintained and counsel on signs of adalimumab treatment failure.
